title: Step pyramid design at Angkor Thom
summary: Matt tells of Step pyramid design at Angkor Thom, about uncertain (conventionally after 1000 AD) at Angkor Thom, Cambodia, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: step pyramid design I've also seen an angor Tom in Cambodia

plain: A guest named Matt, on Jesse Michels' podcast about a possible great event around 12,000 BC, says he has seen the same step pyramid design, a pyramid built in stacked tiers, at Angkor Thom, an ancient temple city in Cambodia. The point of noting it is that matching designs far apart might, to him, suggest a shared lost source.
